panels.speaker: Narrator
panels.text: Reality unravels at the seams. The ground beneath your feet is not ground but the edge of nothing — a precipice overlooking an abyss that stares back. The Prime Corruptor manifests from the void itself, a shape that hurts to perceive.

panels.speaker: Prime Corruptor
panels.text: You carry fragments of my will in your pockets and call them artifacts. You burn my children in their groves and call it valor. I am the corruption you fight, Shopkeeper. I am what lies beneath every region you have 'saved.'

panels.speaker: Prime Corruptor
panels.text: This ends as it was always going to end. Not with your victory. With understanding.

panels.speaker: Narrator
panels.text: The Prime Corruptor does not scream as it dies. It sighs — a sound like a door closing on a room you can never enter again. The void tears seal themselves, light returning in hesitant threads.

panels.speaker: Narrator
panels.text: Through the closing rifts, you glimpse fragments of every region you have fought through — the forest, the mire, the shore, the peaks, the expanse, the necropolis. All connected. All part of one pattern, now broken.

panels.speaker: Narrator
panels.text: The Grail pulses once, warm and bright, and the last of the void retreats. The land breathes again. The Shopkeeper's journey is not over — but this chapter is. What comes next depends on what you've built, and what you're willing to risk.

panels.speaker: Prime Corruptor
panels.text: Rest now. The void is patient. It will be here when you return. It will always be here.
